_note: PAT-230 end to end on the real stack. (1) A value set is created through POST /api/value-sets with one LOINC code and activated. (2) An eCQM whose numerator is `exists [Observation: "Smoke HbA1c Orders"]` is published; the artifact stores the value set the way the picker does ({name, oid: url}). The generated CQL must declare the URL (it used to declare the NAME as the URL, so nothing could resolve it). (3) Evaluate: adults p1-p4 are IP/denominator; only p1 has an Observation coded 4548-4 -> numerator 1, 25%. p3's glucose Observation and child p5's HbA1c must not count. (4) Version 2.0.0 adds 17856-6 and is activated; the measure references the value set unversioned, so the SAME measure now resolves the newest active version: p2 joins -> numerator 2, 50%. Version 1.0.0 must still hold exactly one code. (5) The exchange package embeds the platform value set in full (source=platform, version 2.0.0, both codes) and the conformance report has no 'could not be resolved' warning for it.
